blurb: If you are interested in exploring the coastline of Southern California within Los Angeles County, consider this exclusive 3.5-hour custom tour covering Santa Monica, Venice Beach, and Malibu. Your knowledgeable and courteous guide will pick you up from your specified location in Hollywood or Beverly Hills, offering you a comprehensive scenic overview of some of the world's most renowned beaches.
